note: metatag_async_widget provides one field widget plugin, metatag_async_widget_firehose ('Advanced meta tags form (async)'), for the metatag field type; AsyncMetatagFirehose extends core Metatag's MetatagFirehose. It defers building the heavy meta-tags form behind a 'Customize meta tags' button (AJAX rebuild); unexpanded saves preserve existing meta-tag values. Enabled per field on Manage form display -> the metatag field's component becomes type: metatag_async_widget_firehose in the entity_form_display config entity. Inherits the 'sidebar' widget setting (schema field.widget.settings.metatag_async_widget_firehose extends ...metatag_firehose). configure=null; no permissions/Drush. Introspection/execution cases create namespaced metatag fields (field_maw_*) on Article and read/verify the widget type + sidebar setting in the live core.entity_form_display.node.article.default config.

evals.prompt: What is the machine name (id) of the field widget that metatag_async_widget provides, which field type is it for, and which core Metatag widget does it extend?
evals.expected_output: It provides the widget metatag_async_widget_firehose ('Advanced meta tags form (async)') for the 'metatag' field type; AsyncMetatagFirehose extends core Metatag's MetatagFirehose widget.

evals.prompt: How does metatag_async_widget make entity edit forms faster, and what does the editor see initially instead of the full meta tags form?
evals.expected_output: It defers building the large Metatag firehose form: the editor initially sees only a 'Customize meta tags' button, and clicking it triggers an AJAX rebuild that renders the real form. Saving without expanding keeps the existing meta tags. This avoids building the heavy form on every render.

evals.prompt: There's no settings page for metatag_async_widget. How do I actually turn it on for a Metatag field, and what widget setting does it inherit from the core firehose widget?
evals.expected_output: There is no configure route (configure=null). On the entity's Manage form display, set the Metatag field's widget to 'Advanced meta tags form (async)' (type metatag_async_widget_firehose). It inherits the 'sidebar' setting (whether the form joins the node advanced sidebar group).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a Metatag field configured to use metatag_async_widget's async widget. Inspect the live default form display for Article and give the machine name of the widget plugin used by the field_maw_meta field.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_maw_meta component has type: metatag_async_widget_firehose.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has two Metatag fields, field_maw_async and field_maw_std. Exactly one uses the metatag_async_widget asynchronous widget. Inspect the live form display and state which field uses the async widget.
evals.expected_output: field_maw_async uses the async widget: its component type is metatag_async_widget_firehose, whereas field_maw_std uses the core metatag_firehose widget.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a Metatag field field_maw_task using the standard 'Advanced meta tags form' (metatag_firehose) widget. Switch it to metatag_async_widget's asynchronous widget on the default form display, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default set the field_maw_task component's widget type to metatag_async_widget_firehose (e.g. via Manage form display or setComponent) and save.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article field field_maw_task2 already uses metatag_async_widget's async widget, but its 'sidebar' setting is off. Turn on the sidebar setting so the meta tags form is placed in the node advanced sidebar group, and apply it to the live form display.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default set the field_maw_task2 component's settings.sidebar to true (widget type stays metatag_async_widget_firehose) and save.
